alerts.title: Abdominal Pain as Possible ART Toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines list abdominal pain as a symptom for TDF toxicity (chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, Fanconi syndrome) and for DTG toxicity (hepatotoxicity, hypersensitivity). The patient presents with abdominal pain but has a normal appetite and no fever. Non-drug causes, such as gastrointestinal infection or other conditions, should also be considered in the differential diagnosis.

evidence.recommended_action: Screen for developing signs/symptoms using the pharmacovigilance tool and investigate based on clinical suspicion.

alerts.title: Annual Renal Monitoring for TDF Due
alerts.message: Guidelines state that for experienced patients on TDF, serum creatinine and eGFR should be done every 12 months. The patient's latest creatinine result is from 78 days ago (Nov 2025). While this value is normal (82 umol/L), there is no documented annual schedule, creating a potential monitoring gap for renal function.

evidence.recommended_action: Schedule annual serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring for this patient on TDF.
